title: A transcript line larger than maxFrame: TX pieces with more:true
description: Real transcripts carry lines up to 1.5 MB (base64 images). The daemon never sends a frame above the negotiated maxFrame: a delta is cut into pieces of <= 48 KiB regardless of line ends; every piece but the last carries more:true, f/o are file offsets of the piece. The client concatenates pieces and hands the delta (f of the first, o of the last) to the transcript reader once the last piece arrived. This connection negotiated the minimum maxFrame 65536.
framing: every frame: u32be len | u8 type | u8 flags | u16be hlen | header JSON | blob; each (conn, dir) stream starts with the 8-byte magic
